blocks.tamil_translation: “When the Adhan is called for Salah, Shaytan turns his back and runs away, loudly passing wind so that the sound of the Adhan does not reach his ears; then, when the Adhan is finished, he comes back. When the Iqamah is called he runs away again. When the Iqamah is finished, he comes back to put whisperings into the mind of the one praying. He says to the one praying, “Think of such-and-such a matter.' He reminds the one praying of all the matters that were not in his mind before the Salah. In the end the one praying does not even know how many rak'ahs he has prayed,” Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ قَالَ: لَوْ يَعْلَمُ النَّاسُ مَافِي النِّدَاءِ وَالصَّفِّ اْلاَوَّلِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَجِدُوا إِلَّا أَنْ يَسْتَهِمُوا عَلَيْهِ لَاسْتَهَمُوا.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: (وهو جزء من الحديث) رواه البخاري باب الاستهام في الاذان، رقم:٦١٥
blocks.tamil_translation: “If people knew the reward of calling the Adhan and the reward of praying in the first row, and found that the only way to get it was by drawing lots, they would draw lots to choose it,” Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ سَلْمَانَ الْفَارِسِيِّ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: إِذَا كَانَ الرَّجُلُ بِأَرْضِ قِيٍّ فَحَانَتِ الصَّلَاةُ فَلْيَتَوَضَّأْ، فَإِنْ لَمْ يَجِدْ مَاءً فَلْيَتَيَمَّمْ فَإِنْ أَقَامَ صَلَّي مَعَهُ مَلَكَاهُ، وَإِنْ أَذَّنَ وَأَقَامَ صَلَّي خَلْفَهُ مِنْ جُنُودِ اللهِ مَالَا يُرَي طَرَفَاهُ.
blocks.tamil_translation: “When the time of Salah comes while a person is in the wilderness, let him make Wudu
